Auto-select "auto" bandcount3 for a single biomarker's per-marker step

Source: R/dynamicPredictionShared.R
auto_tune_marker_bandcount3.Rd

dynamicPredictionBioAll()'s counterpart to auto_tune_bandcount(): bandcount3 only controls compute_bio_marker_step()'s own candidate-value grid (Y_all), not the shared step, so it is tuned per biomarker by re-calling compute_bio_marker_step() directly against an already-computed shared object (from compute_bio_shared_step()), rather than re-running the whole dynamicPredictionBio() pipeline – which would recompute the shared denominator on every doubling round, for every biomarker, exactly the redundant work dynamicPredictionBioAll() is meant to avoid. Same doubling-until-stable check as auto_tune_bandcount() (compares Y_predict via max_relative_diff(), capped at max_rounds doublings, warns instead of erroring if not converged by then).

Usage

auto_tune_marker_bandcount3(
  shared,
  bio_i,
  long_fit_all,
  survival_fit_all,
  prediction_time,
  horizon,
  time_variable,
  survival_variable_all,
  survival_trans_function,
  tol = 0.01,
  max_rounds = 2,
  multiplier = 2
)

Arguments

shared

Output of compute_bio_shared_step().

bio_i

See dynamicPredictionBio.

long_fit_all

See dynamicPredictionBio.

survival_fit_all

See dynamicPredictionBio.

prediction_time

See dynamicPredictionBio.

horizon

See dynamicPredictionBio.

time_variable

See dynamicPredictionBio.

survival_variable_all

See dynamicPredictionBio.

survival_trans_function

See dynamicPredictionBio.

Value

A list with result (compute_bio_marker_step()'s return value at the resolved bandcount3) and bandcount3 (the resolved numeric value).
